Pandavani legend Teejan Bai dies at 70

Renowned folk artist Teejan Bai, celebrated for her exponent of Pandavani, a traditional folk art form narrating the Mahabharata, has passed away at the age of 70. Her demise was mourned by prominent political figures including the President, Prime Minister, and state Chief Ministers. The Chhattisgarh government announced plans to name a school after her in tribute.
